Later OnLoad recreates the machine Ruby tile whenever Center scene>=5.
Rainbow Pass enables the later ferry menu in the original source, but this bounded package ends at receiving it; no later-island destination may silently load an absent map.
Do not run Sapphire handoff, SetPostgameFlags, FLAG_SYS_CAN_LINK_WITH_RS or InitRoamer at this milestone.
Preserve one-time HM06 gift with FLAG_GOT_HM06 and original explanatory dialogue.
Spa coordinate events heal the party and set temporary VAR_TEMP_1=1; no portable or global healing service is invented.
HM06 ownership is not a substitute for learning Rock Smash or satisfying the original field-move checks.
